dedupe_keys.name: global near real time daily apparent temperature and heat wave dataset 2006 2020

description: The Chinese Academy of Sciences publishes global apparent-temperature and heatwave data calculated from ERA5 near-surface temperature, wind, dewpoint and radiation. The associated GATHW toolbox supports three calculation methods and grids of 0.25, 0.5 and one degree. The deposited products cover 2006–2020, with daily apparent temperature and annual heatwave data supplied as NetCDF files and RAR archives. Zenodo makes them public and free under CC-BY-4.0. The provider describes near-real-time toolbox operation, but that claim does not make this fixed deposit a current observational feed. A limitation is that apparent temperature depends on the chosen formula and cannot represent individual indoor exposure directly. The grids can supply heat-stress conditions for healthcare demand, outdoor-space or cooling-load simulations. They complement the underlying ERA5 meteorology with derived human-perception indicators. The stated accuracy improvements were not independently assessed.
